skill_name: Construct a story that combines elements of fantasy and reality.
workflow: Once upon a time there was a boy named Tom who lived in a small town. Tom was an ordinary boy, nothing special about him from the outside. However, Tom had a special power, he had the ability to make his fantasies come to life by using his words. Whenever he used his power, his reality would blend with a new fantasy world, filled with dragons, wizards and magical creatures.
